method: Read-only clones of ml-explore/mlx and ml-explore/mlx-c; each pinned revision checked out in its own worktree. The four MLX-C patches were applied locally, in the script's order, from `git diff <commit>^ <commit>` of the patch commits themselves (all four descend from v0.6.0 and applied cleanly). No numerical operation of any kind was executed; no MLX library was loaded.

repository_anchor.subject: merge: F020 Slice 1 -- native Safetensors catalog and MLX affine representation

left_at_upstream_default.MLX_METAL_JIT: OFF (CMakeLists.txt:44) -> kernels are compiled ahead of time into mlx.metallib
left_at_upstream_default.CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: unset -> no -mmacosx-version-min for the Metal compiler (CMakeLists.txt:197-202)

build_dependent.MLX_METAL_VERSION: queried from the runner's `xcrun -sdk macosx metal` at configure time (CMakeLists.txt:203-207)
build_dependent.NAX kernels: built only if MLX_METAL_VERSION >= 400 and MACOS_SDK_VERSION >= 26.2, otherwise MLX_METAL_NO_NAX is defined (mlx/backend/metal/kernels/CMakeLists.txt:158-176)
build_dependent.Metal toolchain: downloaded by xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain if absent (scripts/ci/install_native_mlx.sh:13-16); version not pinned

native_mlx_c.tag: v0.6.0 (annotated tag; resolves to this commit)

patches.source: scripts/ci/install_native_mlx.sh:38-52 (downloaded as https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-c/commit/<commit>.patch?full_index=1, sha256-checked, then git apply)
patches.patch_hash_verification: Verified at build time, not re-derived here: scripts/ci/install_native_mlx.sh downloads each patch and runs `shasum -a 256 -c` against the pinned value before `git apply` (install_native_mlx.sh:38-46, check at line 45); the script runs under `set -euo pipefail` (line 3), so a mismatch fails the build. This research reconstructed the patched tree from the commit objects only to read source.
patches.effect_on_in_scope_api: none: mlx_dequantize (mlx/c/ops.h:359-369) and mlx_quantized_matmul (mlx/c/ops.h:809-819) declarations are identical before and after the patches; array, stream, device, error and memory APIs used here are unchanged by them

python_wheel.requirement: mlx==0.32.0 (pyproject.toml:10), resolved in uv.lock:43-65 with mlx-metal==0.32.0 (uv.lock:67-75)

upstream_source.provenance_caveat: uv.lock pins wheel hashes, not a build provenance; the mapping wheel -> tag commit is by version label only (U14), and the wheel's build options are unknown (U10)

python_wheel.ci_interpreter: Python 3.13.13 (.github/workflows/macos.yml:212) on runs-on: macos-15 (macos.yml:162); by tag specificity the installed files are expected to be the cp313 macosx_15_0 mlx wheel and the macosx_15_0 mlx-metal wheel -- an inference, to be recorded at run time
python_wheel.observation_on_sizes: the macosx_26_0 mlx-metal wheel is ~15.7 MB larger than the 14_0/15_0 wheels, consistent with (not proof of) NAX kernels being present only in the 26_0 build (U10)

repository_bridge.location: crates/stream/src/apple_mlx_bridge.mm (Objective-C++ over MLX-C) and crates/stream/src/apple_mlx_bridge.rs (Rust FFI), built by crates/stream/build.rs:40-55 under cfg(pulsar_native_mlx)
repository_bridge.array_creation: only mlx_array_new_data_managed_payload with MLX_FLOAT32, rank 1 or 2 (apple_mlx_bridge.mm:470-530, rank check 483, dtype 516); zero-copy when MLX can wrap the pointer, otherwise MLX copies and calls the deleter at once (mlx array.cpp:88-107)
repository_bridge.dtypes: float32 only (import, matvec dtype check 625-631, copy-out 673)
repository_bridge.ownership: OwnershipState refcount shared between the Rust wrapper and the MLX deleter callback (apple_mlx_bridge.mm:109-142, 501-529); Rust lifetimes tie MlxArray<'a> to the borrowed &'a mut [f32] and the context (apple_mlx_bridge.rs:252-262, 453-526); Drop frees (632-636, 697-709)
repository_bridge.stream_device: single process-wide context (apple_mlx_bridge.mm:359-364); mlx_set_default_device/stream are changed globally (387, 406) and restored to CPU on destroy (226-250)
repository_bridge.errors: status codes checked and turned into strings (apple_mlx_bridge.rs:242-245); NO mlx_set_error_handler is installed anywhere under crates/, so an MLX exception reaches MLX-C's default handler, which exits the process (mlx-c error.cpp:12-15)
repository_bridge.freeze_status: crates/stream/{build.rs, src/apple_mlx_bridge.rs, src/apple_mlx_bridge.mm, src/apple_mlx_deallocation_observer.mm} are still byte-identical to the sha256 bindings in specs/017-rust-native-inference-runtime/contracts/f017-native-bounded-p1-admission-contract-v2.json code_manifest (checked at the anchor), and are enumerated by crates/f017-native/src/contract.rs:201-230. They must not be edited; Slice 2B code lives in a new crate.

dequantize host dispatch, one thread per packed byte

source.fields: observations.census.tensor_families (U32 weight shapes and BF16 scales shapes per family and layer-index set), observations.census.configuration (default bits 4, group 64, affine) and observations.census.modules.families (resolved bits per family: explicit 8-bit group-64 overrides, otherwise the default)
source.status: census evidence is sanitized and not yet committed; hashes as read on 2026-09-23

production_geometry.method: for each quantized module family variant: weight_shape from tensor_families[<family>.weight] matched by layer-index set; N = weight_shape[-2]; K = weight_shape[-1]*32/bits with the variant's resolved bits; leading = weight_shape[:-2]; cross-checked exactly against the census's in_features/out_features/leading and against scales_shape[-1]*group_size == K

v1_geometry_tested.OP-DQ: rank-2 weight, K <= 16384, rows <= 16384, K % group == 0

production_geometry.meaning: IN_V1_DOMAIN means only that the shape passes the v1 geometry refusals. It does NOT mean the shape is qualified: v1 qualifies the primitives on small fixtures (largest K 4096), and none of these production shapes is covered by v1 evidence. OUT_OF_V1_DOMAIN shapes are refused by the bridge.

production_geometry.metadata_vs_numerical_admission: The census establishes metadata compatibility only (bits, group size, dtypes, shapes). It does not establish that real payload values (scales, biases, activations) fall inside D-NUM or D-DQ; that requires payload reads, which are not authorized.
